title: ½ Price Connoisseur Ice Cream Tub Varieties 1L $6.50 @ Woolworths
body:
Deal: ½ Price Connoisseur Ice Cream Tub Varieties 1L $6.50 @ Woolworths

[iseeyou1312] This post made me think that they were making Connoisseur Gourmet Ice Cream Crunchy Peanut Butter Salted Caramel again. Alas, tis not the case.
[x1dude] I never even got to try it :(
At least Mint and Cookies is back!
[Buttershoes] Same with the Chocolate Brownie Custard. My kids love that and no longer available.
[GreenGuava] You could also stack with this weekend's ShopBack Receipt Quest for a bonus $1 cashback.
[Jessie Ryder] Same time as Coles, is this to prove they are not fixing the market
[Ventak] Just a note that Connoisseur announced on their FB page that they're discontinuing Cafe Grande due to supply issues with the Grande Marnier syrup used as part of it.
[muwu] I had my first tub a week or two ago maybe for the first time in 3-4 years…. quality has dropped through the floor. Won't be touching this stuff again
[1ozbargainer] Kapiti icecream from aldi, it's $6.99 for 1L, real icecream from new zealand
[badjazy] @1ozbargainer: Best so far, better than haagan daaz too.
[kahn] @badjazy: There are supposedly only two Kapiti flavours - vanilla and caramel. I found the latter to have a terrible taste. Most people commenting here seem to forget that the main appeal of Connoisseur is the range of flavours. Although, now cafe grande is missing.
[albiilive] This one went downhill after they stopped stocking my fav, Gingerbread flavor ;_;… I dream of it sometimes haha.
[SydneySpendthrift] Are they still using that seed oil dairy substitute or whatever from that israeli biotech firm?
[gviddy] Wow, so half price is now $6.50. $13 for a tub at normal price. When will this price increase for ice cream end? $20 a tub not far away?
[gviddy] Bulla icecream, has gone down from $12 to $7. Which at $12 was an absolute joke for a tub of Vanilla icecream so people must have stopped buying it and now the regular price is $5 cheaper. $5 cheaper!!! Thats the profit these guys were taking and they still make good profit for it at $7. $12 a tub for that icecream was absurd!
[Bimbobob] Tbh any drop in price is coming at a cost in quality or ingredients being used/reduced/substituted.
[scud70] This is a buying habit colesworth has cultivated in Australia, you will always look for the yellow sticker or mark down label when purchasing (only things that are exempt are milk and bread which have a "reasonable" full price). Colesworth expect the supplier/distributor/importer to foot the discount you see on the shelf, they have a certain number of promotions per year including 50% off, this is why the "normal price" is so high.
[kahn] I think they removed cookies and cream from their 1L tub range a few weeks ago.
[badjazy] What happened? Connoisseur used to be good, now its trash.
